CRON JOB   attendance-regularization-reminder schedule 0 5 * * *      active=true
             SELECT public.notify_attendance_regularization()
CRON JOB   cron-failure-alert                 schedule 15 * * * *     active=true
             SELECT public.alert_cron_failures()
CRON JOB   dormant-user-check                 schedule 30 4 * * 1     active=true
              select net.http_post( url := (select value from app_config where key = 'supabase_url') || '/functions/v1/dormant-user-check', body := '{}'::jsonb, headers := jsonb_build_object( 'Content-Type', 'application/json', 'Authorization', 'Bearer ' || (select value from app_config where key = 'service_role_key') ) ); 
CRON JOB   expire-idempotency-keys            schedule 0 * * * *      active=true
             DELETE FROM idempotency_keys WHERE created_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
CRON JOB   external-heartbeat                 schedule */5 * * * *    active=true
             SELECT public.external_heartbeat()
CRON JOB   kitchen-cutoff-push-tick           schedule * * * * *      active=true
             SELECT trigger_kitchen_cutoff_pushes()
CRON JOB   kitchen-push-missing-alert         schedule */10 * * * *   active=true
             SELECT public.alert_missing_kitchen_pushes()
CRON JOB   low-wallet-check                   schedule 0 4 * * *      active=true
              select net.http_post( url := (select value from app_config where key = 'supabase_url') || '/functions/v1/low-wallet-check', body := '{}'::jsonb, headers := jsonb_build_object( 'Content-Type', 'application/json', 'Authorization', 'Bearer ' || (select value from app_config where key = 'service_role_key') ) ); 
CRON JOB   prune-operational-logs             schedule 0 21 * * *     active=true
             SELECT public.prune_operational_logs()
CRON JOB   subscription-expiry-push           schedule 30 3 * * *     active=true
             select net.http_post( url := (select value from app_config where key = 'supabase_url') || '/functions/v1/subscription-expiry-push', body := '{}', headers := jsonb_build_object( 'Content-Type', 'application/json', 'Authorization', 'Bearer ' || (select value from app_config where key = 'service_role_key') ) );
